$comment: Stackra file contract — Purpose: the mobile app's own strings (namespace `mobile::`). Boundary: same keys in every locale (gen fails otherwise); every Arabic plural carries all six CLDR categories (zero, one, two, few, many, other) or gen fails. Derived keys sit under their kind segment and are never authored elsewhere: `routes.<route>.title` (also the tab label), `documents.<document>.title`, `enums.<enum>.<code>`, `errors.<code>.message`; every other key is authored. Other modules' strings are overrides under assets/overrides/<namespace>/. Runtime: react-native. Governing contract: ADR 0294 (decision 20), ADR 0192, ADR 0234
